title: Metaphrasis in Ecclesiasten: Gregory's metaphrase on the Book of Ecclesiastes
pass_a_gloss: Metaphrasis in Ecclesiasten (Metaphrase on Ecclesiastes). Gregory Thaumaturgus provides a metaphrase (paraphrase/commentary) on the Book of Ecclesiastes. The work proceeds chapter by chapter, paraphrasing and explaining the text. Billius provides scholia on the metaphrase. Vossius notes reference earlier interpretations. The metaphrase covers Ecclesiastes 1-12, explaining the vanity of earthly things, the proper use of wealth, the certainty of death, the fear of God, and the final judgment. It follows the structure of the biblical text, providing a running paraphrase with theological commentary.
source_ref: Opera Omnia (Migne PG 10), Metaphrasis in Ecclesiasten (lines ~13593-19500)
notes_covered: Metaphrase covers Ecclesiastes 1-12 chapter by chapter
ANF 4 (Crombie) has English translation; new English from Latin required
